description: This file contains firmware functions for managing extended FLASH operations on STM32F4 microcontrollers, including erase, programming, and option bytes configuration, with support for dual bank and protection features.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase
methods.description: Performs mass erase or sector erase of FLASH memory, with polling for completion.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase_IT
methods.description: Performs mass erase or sector erase of FLASH memory, with interrupt enabled.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBProgram
methods.description: Programs option bytes such as write protection, read protection, user options, and BOR level.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_AdvOBProgram
methods.description: Programs advanced option bytes like PCROP, dual bank boot, and protection for specific STM32F4 series.

methods.name: FLASH_FlushCaches
methods.description: Flushes instruction and data caches to ensure data consistency.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OB_GetWRP
methods.description: Gets the write protection option bytes for bank 1.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OB_GetBank2WRP
methods.description: Gets the write protection option bytes for bank 2.
